slice: Use Arrow zip for same-type column/literal CASE branches

case_zip.reason: The native CASE path removes branch filtering for same-type column/literal branches. The dynamic DOUBLE query improves 9.19% with 9.33% fewer execution instructions. Existing lateral queries with the literal in THEN also improve; semantic replay and scoped native oracles pass. No stable control regression remains in the measured confirmations.

float_hash.reason: With CASE applied to both variants, the dynamic DOUBLE hash delta is +0.18% in 16 pairs and +0.11% in a separate 24-pair series; both paired intervals include zero. The four long-list gains remain 15.43%-19.31%. This slice does not repeat the whole previous generic benchmark matrix on the changed baseline, so retain the hash change as a separate candidate.
float_hash.next_step: Review the CASE patch, then use it as the common baseline for the broader existing hash benchmark matrix before deciding adoption.

scope: One mixed-predicate CASE branch, one Column and one Literal, with identical Arrow data types. Existing all-true/all-false/scalar shortcuts, scalar/scalar dispatch, coercion and selective evaluation of other expressions remain in place. No new node, UDF, dependency or planner rewrite.

variant_names.original: Accepted Boolean-cast runtime without CASE zip, float hash candidate or native add-zero.
variant_names.before: Accepted runtime plus CASE zip only.
variant_names.after: Same CASE runtime plus the existing two-line float hash candidate.
